feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 11 September 2026 11:28am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 11 September 2026 at 11:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds later.


##Synopsis##

High pressure near the Azores extends a ridge across the area.


##Wind##

West or Northwest 3 or 4, backing West or Southwest through the afternoon. Increasing South or Southwest 4 or 5 in the evening, further increasing 5 to 7 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building moderate occasionally rough overnight.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain or drizzle spreading from the west overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or Southwest 5 or 6 occasionally 7 at first, veering west tomorrow afternoon, the northwest 3 or 4 in the evening.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, occasionally rough at first, falling slight later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, only isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.
